rulings.evidence: Brine water: nothing is bought and it is poured off. Follows the 'cold water' -> not-purchased ruling of 2026-08-26.
Vocabulary row Sugar [sugar] is same form ('granulated' is what plain sugar is); board carries sugar 7 of 7.

rulings.raw: 3-4 pounds chicken wings, (tips removed; drumettes and flats separated)
rulings.evidence: Exact prior ruling for this phrase on 2026-08-26; chicken-wings is a live board id at 7 of 7, so a reuse. Raw bone-in wings.
No commodity claims a generic neutral oil and I will not bridge it onto olive-oil (different price class). 1 tbsp on the grates: pantry-static pricing is safe.
Salted vs unsalted is the same product at the same shelf price, unlike a true form flip; board carries butter 7 of 7 and the DB has the row.
The 'ground cloves' near-row is a keyword miss on the word clove - this is fresh bulb garlic, board 6 of 7.
'Freshly ground' is a grinder instruction, not a different food; board carries black-pepper 7 of 7.
Vocabulary row Parmesan Cheese [parmesan]; grated is the standard sold cut of parmesan. Board showed no commodity claim, so the term is reported absent for pricing.
The 'fresh' form flag is spurious - chopped cilantro for garnish IS the fresh bunch; board 6 of 7.
REFUSED the board's shredded-cheese bridge: that id prices bagged cheddar/blend, a different cheese and price class from parmesan.

macro_cross_check: Source band 660 cal / 50 g protein per serving over 6. My build: 1588 g bone-in wings (about 65% edible) = 175 g edible per serving -> ~389 cal / 32 g P, plus butter 18.8 g (135 cal) and parmesan 5.8 g (24 cal, 1.7 P) = about 548 cal and 34 g protein. Calories sit inside the 400-650 band; PROTEIN IS 32% UNDER the published figure. The gap is explained by bone yield: 50 g/serving requires treating the full bone-in 265 g as edible meat, which no wing does. I did not raise the grams to chase it - flagging instead, and the DB row for Chicken Wings (which I cannot read) should be checked for whether it is on an edible or a bone-in basis.
